title: feat(security)!: an AI service account is the agent principal of its own requests, under the agent ceiling
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9H3PTJ3DC1WnJJ1S3UcQwgg)_

Part of #31739

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — content/docs/ai/agents.mdx, content/docs/permissions/index.mdx (the AI service account and the agent ceiling its sets are read under; an author first meets an account at PR-3's registration door, so the teaching lands with it)

Clause-② measured: no published key, export or shape is removed or retyped; one export is added to plugin-security (`DESTRUCTIVE_CLASS_KEYS`) and one to core (`isAgentAccountRow`), and the connector-connection door's delegated-caller union gains `agent_account`. The narrowing: every agent principal's permission sets are read under the agent ceiling, and a non-system write giving an AI service account a set above it is refused. Measured first-party: 0 of the 3 OAuth agent ceiling sets carries a clamped bit, and no account row can exist until PR-3. Changeset level `patch`, `!` in its headline, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 服务账号（`principal_kind = agent` 的 `sys_user`）用自己的 API 密钥访问时，就是它自己这个 agent 主体：`principalKind: 'agent'`、没有 `onBehalfOf`、拿不到 `everyone` 锚点权限集、没有系统权限、也永远不是平台或组织管理员。所有 agent 主体的权限集在求值时按「agent 上限」裁掉 View All、Modify All、转移/恢复/清除、系统权限和管理范围；给账号分配超上限的权限集（或绑定它的岗位）会被按名字拒绝。
- 为什么改：ADR-0151 D3，三步拆分的第二步（PR-1 #31779 已合并），PR-3 的注册与密钥入口建在它上面。
- 风险与回滚：解析权限时对 `sys_user` 的那一次读取改为无条件（原来只在配置了平台管理员时才读），每次解析多一次按主键读取；OAuth 连接的助手所用的 3 个第一方权限集不含任何被裁的位，行为不变（测试实测）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`（账号分支）、`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/agent-ceiling-clamp.ts` 与 `security-plugin-permission-sets.ts`（唯一求值入口的裁剪）、`agent-account-grant-refusal.ts`（分配拒绝，留意「调用者读不到持有人就不判」的分支）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/agent-ceiling-clamp.test.ts src/agent-account-grant-refusal.test.ts`，应见 20 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（席位按约定做 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 评审）。

## What changes

- **D3, the account is its own subject.** `resolveUserAuthzGrants` reads the user's `sys_user` row on every resolution (one read, by id, as the system; it used to be read only when a platform-admin config was set). A row whose `principal_kind` is `agent` resolves as `principalKind: 'agent'`, without the `everyone` anchor's sets, with no system permission, and with no platform or organization administrator standing, whatever its grants say. `assembleExecutionContext` carries the kind onto the context, with no `onBehalfOf`. REST, `/mcp` and stdio keys all go through this one resolver, so the key admission needed no change of its own.
- **The ceiling, at evaluation.** `resolvePermissionSetsForContextUnmemoized`, the one choke point every evaluator reads, clamps every agent principal's sets (the account and the OAuth-delegated agent alike): `viewAllRecords`, `modifyAllRecords` and the destructive class's keys (`DESTRUCTIVE_CLASS_KEYS`, derived from `DESTRUCTIVE_OPERATIONS`) are cleared on every object entry, `'*'` included; `systemPermissions` is emptied and `adminScope` removed. A clean set is returned as the same object; a breaching one as a fresh copy, so the catalogs are never mutated. An account's floor is the restricted agent set, so a new account can do nothing until it is granted something.
- **The ceiling, at assignment.** A non-system insert or update on `sys_user_permission_set` or `sys_user_position` that would leave an AI service account holding a set above the ceiling (directly, or through a position that binds one) is refused `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, `invalid_value` at `permission_set` or `position`, naming the set and what in it breaches. Priority 45, after the ceiling-set (35) and membership (40) refusals. A holder the caller's own door does not read is not judged here (the engine's reference check answers it, and the membership refusal's per-write read is reused), so the refusal never names the kind of a user the caller cannot read. A person's grants are never judged. Registered on the system-context page as row 23g.
- **Inventory.** Flow runs (trigger door, action door, run setup, resume), the connector-connection door (new caller kind `agent_account`), the action audit line, attachment and comment access, the mention gate and the access explainer read an account as the agent it is.
- **Standing guards.** `principal_kind` is listed as an immutable non-standing column in the admin standing surface and the last-admin guard's exclusions.

Nothing registers an AI service account yet; the registration, key and lifecycle doors follow in PR-3 (`Fixes #31739`).

## Tests

New, 55 cases, all green:
- core: `resolve-authz-context.agent-account.test.ts` (8), `assemble-execution-context.test.ts` (+3).
- plugin-security: `agent-ceiling-clamp.test.ts` (10, including the measured 0 of 3 first-party OAuth ceiling sets clamped), `agent-account-grant-refusal.test.ts` (10, real ObjectQL + SQLite with the real SecurityPlugin; two pin the unreadable-holder and no-`sys_user` stand-downs), `effective-access.test.ts` (+2).
- runtime: `security/resolve-execution-context.agent-account.test.ts` (real resolver + real SecurityPlugin over `/mcp` and the dispatcher; clamp; `everyone` and wildcard refused; human and OAuth CONTROLs), `flow-run-agent-account-kind.test.ts`, `automation-connector-connection-door.test.ts` (+1).
- service-automation: `run-agent-account-kind.test.ts` (5).
- rest: `rest-api-key-agent-account.test.ts` (2). mcp: `__tests__/stdio-agent-account.test.ts` (2).

Forced test edits (the resolver's `sys_user` read is now unconditional, as approved):
- `resolve-authz-context.batch-equivalence.golden.json`: the `seeded-permissions-and-email` case records one more query, `{"object":"sys_user","where":{"id":"u_seed"},"limit":1,"isSystem":true}`; the header notes it as the sixth recorded move.
- `resolve-authz-context.platform-admin-config.test.ts`: the describe is renamed to say the read is one read, config or not; "fully-seeded" now expects one read and no `PLATFORM_ADMIN`; "…and costs no sys_user read of its own" now expects one read on both postures.
- `resolve-user-grants-cache.test.ts` pin 5: `sys_user` calls are two, one per real resolution.

## Acceptance notes

- PR-2 of the approved three-PR serial split. The card stays open; PR-3 carries the D4/D6 doors and the ADR-0151 status-line fix.
- The account's kind is read from the resolver's row read, not from the key admission projection: adding the column there could refuse keys on a store without it, and the resolver serves every caller.
- `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` gains one row for the new runtime test's `findOne` double, written by the gate's own `--write`, as its message asks.
- Seat: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review owed on this PR.

## Verification

<details><summary>Tests and typecheck</summary>

All under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, `npx vitest run` per package, after merging main at 015ae70e:
- core 3301 passed; plugin-auth 4443 passed / 10 skipped; plugin-audit 1225; service-automation 3498; service-storage 1428; objectql 11821; rest 7940 passed / 355 skipped; mcp 981.
- plugin-security: the first run had 8 reds in `grant-holder-membership-refusal.test.ts` and `tenant-wall-organization-removal.test.ts` (the account refusal read an unreadable holder as the system, and threw where no `sys_user` object is composed). Fixed in 0c2ef425; the re-run at the final head: 6056 passed / 45 skipped, 0 failed.
- runtime: 10513 passed / 19 skipped, 1 failed: `sandbox-relay-unique-violation-wire-code.test.ts` "a script action body that lets the refusal of its write leave" timed out at 5000 ms while the gate loop shared the box; re-run alone, the file passes (13 of 13 with the agent-account file).
- `tsc --noEmit`: core, plugin-security, plugin-audit, service-automation, service-storage, objectql, rest, mcp, runtime, exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on every touched `.ts` file: exit 0.
- Full build (`turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'`, lock): 81 of 81 tasks.

</details>

<details><summary>Full dogfood battery (the `(narrowing)` arm)</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` at the final head 0c2ef425, under the lock, after the full build: 441 files passed / 3 skipped, 3662 tests passed / 42 skipped, 0 failed (VERDICT command-exit 0, 32m40s).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each red, then restored: `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

Each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, committed first; the named pins went red and the file came back with blob == HEAD.
- core A1–A11: the `everyone` skip, the system-permission zeroing, the anchor and config standing checks, the kind stamp, the row predicate, the context copy, the organization-admin standing, and the assembler's account arm, system permissions and precedence.
- plugin-security B1–B10: the clamp wiring, the cleared bits, system permissions, admin scope, the destructive keys, the refusal verdict, its holder read, its registration, the update image, and the effective-access baseline.
- runtime C1–C4: trigger and action forwarding, the trigger CONTROL, the connector caller kind. service-automation D1–D3: run seed, run data context, unseed. E1: the runtime end-to-end clamp.
- F1: the kind on the runtime face. F3: REST and stdio read the core dist, so that leg was held, core rebuilt, both red, then restored and rebuilt green. (F2, the same leg without the rebuild, stayed green and measured nothing.)
- G1: the unreadable-holder stand-down removed: the new pin and the membership refusal's "a holder the caller cannot read is read only through the caller's own door" both red. G2: the no-`sys_user` guard removed: the composition pin red.
- Several first attempts used a replacement that the tool's own count refused (a substring of the anchor, or a common string); they measured nothing and were re-run with distinct replacements.

</details>

<details><summary>Dispatch gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran`: 120 derived, 120 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, every exit 0 at 0c2ef425.
First round (82 families, before the docs row widened the derivation to 120) had six reds, fixed in 211f6ce3 (the changeset) and 0c2ef425 (the rest):
- `check-adr-0087-registration`: the narrowing had no disposition marker; the changeset now carries `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` and the BREAKING banner.
- `check:engine-double-contract`: the clamp test's undriven `findOne` double dropped; the runtime test's pinned `findOne` recorded by the gate's own `--write`.
- `check:objectql-double-limit`: the REST double applies `limit` after the filter.
- `check:where-matcher`: the stdio double refuses a combinator or operator.
- `check:test-source-alias`: module-top `import '@objectstack/objectql'` (REST) and `import '@objectstack/metadata'` (connector door test).
- `check:system-context-census`: row 23g added and the register regenerated.
- `check:type-check-debt` hit the 600 s loop timeout on the first round; it ran to exit 0 in the second.

</details>
